content.short: Augur is a decentralized prediction protocol built on Ethereum.
content.description: Augur operates as a decentralized prediction market platform that relies on a worldwide network of computers to keep it running on Ethereum. In a prediction market, participants place bets on the outcomes of events instead of trading traditional assets, functioning similarly to a generic exchange. Augur allows users to create markets and issue or trade 'shares' that represent a portion of the eventual payouts tied to specific outcomes, all without a central company or single administrator controlling the markets.
